thread:
evan: quick sync on the continuous-batcher boundary. i'm worried adapters are turning into tiny schedulers. want a minimal handshake so adapters can prefetch/warm without owning admission logic.

jess: agree. current coupling leaks eviction and packing complexity into adapters. what's the smallest useful contract?

ev an: (typo) meant evan :) sketch: scheduler grants a short-lived LeaseToken {id, expire_ms, credit_hint, warmup_ref}. adapter uses token to warm and can Redeem(token_id, actual_cost) at dispatch. scheduler can send Evict(token_id) signals.
maria: nice. prefer short ids and numeric fields. couple concerns: 1) revocation latency, 2) provisional-credit leaks.
kyle: propose two cheap guardrails: a heartbeat from adapter while holding token (optional) and a TTL on provisional credits with a reconciler sweep. heartbeat optional because we don't want steady traffic.
evan: heartbeat only when warmup is long (>50ms) and enabled by adapter flag. TTL default 4s; reconciler returns credits and emits orphaned_token metric.
jess: about packing races: what if adapter redeems but scheduler already evicted token to preempt? Redeem must be a CAS: Redeem succeeds only if token active. else return EVICTED and adapter falls back to cold path.
maria: agree. also add a small best-effort Revocation stream (server-streaming) and a localside check at dispatch: scheduler verifies token still active before dispatching any warmed microbatch.
kyle: metrics: token_hold_time, redeem_conflicts, evict_signals_sent, orphaned_tokens_count. alert on orphaned_tokens_count spike and token_hold_time > 70% of expire_ms.
ej: small perf note: keep warmup_ref as a 16-byte token referencing hotstore, not embedding warmup payloads. otherwise RPCs bloat.
evan: implementation plan: 1) compact lease proto; 2) revocation stream + helpers lib; 3) provisional ledger with TTL + reconciler; 4) feature flag and canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
jess: test matrix: adapter crash, network partition (missed evict), redeem losing to evict, scheduler shard failover. add recovery e2e tests asserting no credit leaks and no silent tail regressions.
maria: also require a safe legacy-compat shim so adapters can opt into the new flow without changing everything at once. add verbose lease only for admin debugging.

infra-bot: NOTE: created issue #INF-4002 "lease-token-handshake-and-reconciler" (link: https://redwood/INF-4002)

evan: will draft a short RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and a minimal proto. will ping for reviews.
kyle: thanks — i'll prototype the reconciler and a small harness to simulate evict races.
jess: i'll take ownership of the metrics/alerts and the rollout plan.
maria: great. followups in INF-4002. thanks all :sparkles:
